acceptance.reason: Facade has no-Work/capabilities paths, and a deterministic prepare test verifies Work creation without execution; no conversation test proves greeting/no-work behavior.
Nested facts/references are represented and the offline regression verifies durable task-envelope forwarding.

Facade unit test proves prepared durable Work and short reference without execution, but scripted OpenCode smoke fails SCRIPTED_NATIVE_TASK_ARGS_NOT_OBSERVED before a durable Work is observed; the prepare-to-native-task integration gate fails.
Offline tests cover durable correlation, identity, immutable handoff and replay; this is not evidence of live model behavior.
Unit tests cover human-readable handoff/receipt text and metadata; no actual TUI/session capture verifies the complete user-facing interaction.
Plan adoption checks explicit authorization in code; live plan-only followed by an authorized follow-up was not run.
No real provider session with overlapping child intervals; simulations and unit tests do not prove live overlap.
Declared disjoint writes are tested offline, but no real concurrent OpenCode writers/no-shell flow was exercised.
Offline two-connection SQLite/resource-claim tests cover conflicting and compatible claims; no live provider concurrency is claimed.

Offline tests cover traversal/symlink escapes, protected reads and writes, patch move source/destination, and direct protected-root bash references. Case/hardlink aliases and OS-level shell containment are not certified.

The secure owner-only capabilities.json loader/writer and approved-descriptor/observed-allow predicates are unit-tested and the plugin loads descriptors. Dynamic host discovery, probe and permission wiring are not integrated; no preferred external tool use or fallback was observed live.
CAS/provenance, context snapshot and compaction hook have offline evidence; new real session and live compaction/subagent snapshot remain unverified.
Offline catalog tests prove a skill-only mention creates no approved descriptor and cannot pass isAuthorized; this verifies the catalog invariant, not model behavior under adversarial skill content.
The validator enforces exact coverage of a declared universe, but no complete production repository universe was independently established or reconciled.

A ready-plan filesystem check verifies target existence/newness, path casing and workspace/symlink containment on publish and is awaited again before adoption. It does not establish target-content/behavior correctness or human review; a complete real inventory and content-reviewed ready plan were not demonstrated.

Review validation enforces plan criteria and passing-check evidence in code, but no independent reviewer session or explicit negative-review/criterion-mapping test establishes the full review-failure behavior.
The deterministic kernel test verifies that a blocked branch does not suppress a separate ready branch; live continuation remains unverified.
Continuity snapshot/hook and policy exist, but real cross-session continuity was not observed.

Offline restart reads exact references from durable sidecars, validates receipt state from NativeJournal, enforces parent-session ownership and reconciles accepted/rejected receipts idempotently with work_artifacts. Full claim/bind/sideEffectsMayContinue recovery is not demonstrated.
Migration v6 and older-shaped empty/fixture schemas are tested; migration of a copied real v2 database with non-empty historical receipts was not run.

Installer tests exercise rollback after staged publication failure, model preservation and byte-preservation of instruction files. They do not establish DB backup/rollback or the complete isolated live install acceptance flow.
Continuity policy exists, but NEGATIVE_AMOUNT remains only a fixture without a product-facing amount API/assertion; original security/amount/continuity acceptance is incomplete.
Code gates plan adoption on explicit authorization and reports execution not dispatched; real plan-only/authorized follow-up behavior remains NOT_RUN.
Prompts and trusted-user provenance constrain authority paths; no adversarial README/repository-data session was run to verify untrusted data cannot grant authority.
Isolated OpenCode 1.18.32 agent list loads six roles/eight skills with instruction files absent; the real primary/child/new-session/compaction flow was NOT_RUN.
Offline install/uninstall preserves protected file bytes and absence; byte-identical coexistence through install/uninstall was not run in the isolated live host acceptance scenario.
